bootstrap.method: Efron-Tibshirani 1993 paired percentile bootstrap, stratified by DoE iteration

claim_scope: Leak-free prospective-transfer validity re-attestation for the Guth-Gold scratch-hardness design-rule baseline on Purformance HTE 2K-PUR lacquer only, normalized feature domain [0,1]^4, 3 sequential BO iterations. Supersedes the MAGNITUDES (not the qualitative conclusions) of prospective-transfer-v1. Grants no batch-release, qualification, optimizer, or product-performance authority. Intervals are marginal not conditional. n=41 leak-free prospective observations from a single formulator and a single instrument; Phase-1 would require a cross-formulator dataset and independent wet-lab validation.
convex_hull_membership_test: exact LP feasibility (lambda>=0, sum lambda=1, X_train^T lambda = x_test), scipy.optimize.linprog method=highs, deterministic
gap_this_closes: benchmarks/split-integrity-dedup-v1 corrected guth-gold-physical-baseline-v1, directional-concordance-v1 and alt-reinforcement-law-v1 for duplicate-row leakage under LOIO, but did not touch benchmarks/prospective-transfer-v1, whose forward-chained train{1,2}->test{3} fold independently contains the identical leak (27/42 test rows duplicated verbatim in train). This receipt closes that gap.
honest_interpretation: LEAK-FREE RE-RUN OF prospective-transfer-v1 (still standing, uncorrected as of this run). split-integrity-dedup-v1 (2026-07-30) proved the Purformance iteration workbooks are cumulative snapshots and corrected the module's LOIO-based receipts, but explicitly left prospective-transfer-v1 untouched. This run shows prospective-transfer-v1's forward-chained fold train{1,2}->test{3} (n_train=44, n_test=42) contains 27/42 (64%) duplicate test rows already present verbatim in its own training set -- the identical Kaufman-Rosset-Perlich 2012 leakage class split-integrity-dedup-v1 found elsewhere. Re-running genuine forward-chaining over the DEDUP first-appearance partition (train iter-1 unique (n=17) -> test rows NEW at iter-2 (n=26); train iter-{1,2} unique (n=43) -> test rows NEW at iter-3 (n=15); verified leak-free: 0 and 0 duplicate test rows respectively in the two folds) pools to n=41 prospective observations, down from the receipted 69. Guth-Gold leak-free forward pooled R2 = -0.0165 versus the still-standing receipted value 0.1917 (delta -0.2083) -- the receipted number IS NOT REPRODUCIBLE leak-free under a leak-free protocol. Guth-Gold minus constant-mean delta-R2 = 0.0126, CI [-0.6727, 0.6192] (INCLUDES zero): Guth-Gold does NOT beat the constant baseline prospectively at 95% once memorized rows are excluded. Guth-Gold minus linear-4 delta-R2 = -0.0604, CI [-0.1617, 0.0305] (INCLUDES zero). Hostile-null label-shuffle forward R2 = -0.3026 (<0.10 gate PASS). Binding constraint: pooled prospective n fell from 69 (leaky) to 41 (leak-free), consistent with split-integrity-dedup-v1's finding that this module's binding constraint is sample size, not model form. Grants no batch-release, qualification, optimizer, or product-performance authority.
shared_model_structure: H = H0*(1 + a*Vernetzung + b*HDI_IPDI)*R_GG(phi); phi = cm*Mattierungsmittel + cp*Pigmentpaste; R_GG = 1 + 2.5*phi + 14.1*phi^2; least_squares TRF, bounded, identical init/bounds to parent receipts; deterministic.
split_forward_dedup: forward-chained over the DEDUP first-appearance partition (split-integrity-dedup-v1 protocol): train iter-1 unique (n=17) -> test rows first-appearing at iter-2 (n=26); train iter-{1,2} unique (n=43) -> test rows first-appearing at iter-3 (n=15). Bergmeir-Benitez 2012 / Sheridan 2013 time-split, leak-free by construction.
